name: folder
oqx: select path from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md"

name: nested-folder
oqx: select path from docs where path.startsWith("/books/fiction/") or path == "/books/fiction.md"

name: folder-with-slashes-trimmed
oqx: select path from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md"

name: single-note-by-extension
oqx: select path from docs where path == "/books/index.md"

name: tag
oqx: select path from docs where tags exists { where $it == "book" or $it.startsWith("book/") }

name: nested-tag
oqx: select path from docs where tags exists { where $it == "games/mobas" or $it.startsWith("games/mobas/") }

name: tag-or-tag
oqx: select path from docs where tags exists { where $it == "games/mobas" or $it.startsWith("games/mobas/") } or tags exists { where $it == "games/crpg" or $it.startsWith("games/crpg/") }

name: link-pages-linking-to
oqx: select path from docs where out_links exists { where dst.path.endsWith("/Dataview.md") }

name: link-resolved-by-the-client
oqx: select path from docs where out_links exists { where dst.path == "/tools/Dataview.md" }

name: link-with-heading-and-display
oqx: select path from docs where out_links exists { where dst.path.endsWith("/Dataview.md") }

name: outgoing
oqx: select path from docs where in_links exists { where doc.path.endsWith("/Dataview.md") }

name: link-or-outgoing
oqx: select path from docs where out_links exists { where dst.path.endsWith("/Dataview.md") } or in_links exists { where doc.path.endsWith("/Dataview.md") }

name: empty-link-is-this
oqx: select path from docs where out_links exists { where dst.path == "/projects/alpha.md" }

name: and-negation
oqx: select path from docs where tags exists { where $it == "book" or $it.startsWith("book/") } and !(path.startsWith("/archive/") or path == "/archive.md")

name: bang-negation
oqx: select path from docs where !tags exists { where $it == "draft" or $it.startsWith("draft/") }

name: parentheses
oqx: select path from docs where (path.startsWith("/notes/") or path == "/notes.md") and (tags exists { where $it == "a" or $it.startsWith("a/") } or tags exists { where $it == "b" or $it.startsWith("b/") }) and !out_links exists { where dst.path.endsWith("/Index.md") }

name: symbols-for-and-or
oqx: select path from docs where tags exists { where $it == "a" or $it.startsWith("a/") } and tags exists { where $it == "b" or $it.startsWith("b/") } or tags exists { where $it == "c" or $it.startsWith("c/") }

name: task-sources-go-through-doc
oqx: select path, id, text, checked from blocks where type == "task" and doc.tags exists { where $it == "project" or $it.startsWith("project/") } and doc.out_links exists { where dst.path.endsWith("/Home.md") }
